findings.evidence: Lines 64–69 define the predicates, lines 74–79 only provide elimination, and lines 152–174 define `reflectHom` plus exhaustive simp lemmas; the file-wide attribute at line 51 unnecessarily exposes all three bodies.
findings.fix: Restrict `@[expose]` to `Reflect` if its type-synonym reduction is required, leave `reflectHom` opaque behind its three simp case lemmas, and add introduction/`IsSink_def` and `IsSource_def` characterization lemmas before making those predicates opaque.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `IsSink`, `IsSource`, and `reflectHom`, making downstream code depend on their encodings; the existing elimination and case lemmas already show these are intended as abstract APIs.

summary: The new basic API exposes implementation bodies globally where characteristic lemmas should provide the interface.
